name: Debug Push Permissions

on:
  push:
    branches: ['*']
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  debug:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc' # or specify a version

      - name: Setup GitHub CLI
        uses: cli/cli@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Log environment details
        run: |
          echo "=== Environment Details ==="
          echo "OS: ${{ runner.os }}"
          echo "Runner: ${{ runner.name }}"
          echo "Node version: $(node -v)"
          echo "GitHub Actions version: ${{ github.action }}"
          echo "Workflow run ID: ${{ github.run_id }}"
          echo "Repository: ${{ github.repository }}"
          echo "Ref: ${{ github.ref }}"
          echo "Ref name: ${{ github.ref_name }}"
          echo "Event name: ${{ github.event_name }}"
          echo "============================"

      - name: Log auth status
        run: |
          echo "=== Auth Status ==="
          gh auth status
          echo "===================="

      - name: Log branch protection rules
        run: |
          echo "=== Branch Protection Rules ==="
          BRANCH="${{ github.ref_name }}"
          echo "Fetching protection for branch: $BRANCH"
          # Attempt to fetch protection; ignore errors if not protected
          gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/branches/$BRANCH/protection --jq . || echo "No protection rules found or access denied."
          echo "==============================="
